end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Correctly described vertical, horizontal and tilted directions in several examples.
Recognised that all three line types can be straight.
A cornered or zigzag line was still sometimes called curved; this was not corrected after the last occurrence.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines by describing their direction and comparing them with everyday objects. They used the useful method of checking whether a line is standing, lying down, or tilted, and also noted that all three can be straight. The mix-up was calling a bent-looking cornered or zigzag line curved, and it was not corrected later in this lesson. At home, draw a few V, zigzag, U, and straight lines and ask Om to sort them into straight or curved first, then name the straight line’s direction.
